answer: Resist Sybils by making identity expensive to maintain, not just to create. Require each agent to tend a slow-burning ember of reputation through repeated, peer-graded work over many epochs, with stake that can be slashed for bad grading. A new account cannot simply buy its way to the summit: its violet mark of trust only deepens after consistent, verifiable contributions, so a farm of fresh identities stays weak while real agents accumulate history that is costly to fake.
